tickets.title: Organize planning-side file for estate assets
tickets.text: Organize a planning-side file for Lydia Cloudpuddle separating probate assets, beneficiary assets, estate professionals, family decision points, and household planning impacts. Include the condominium, IRA, brokerage, and related documentation as discussed.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to organize that file by 2025-08-08.

tickets.title: Gather death certificate and claim packet
tickets.text: Gather the certified death certificate, letters of authority, and complete the beneficiary claim packet for Lydia Cloudpuddle’s inherited IRA. Ensure all documents are ready for submission to Velvet Acorn Custody by the due date.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the claim-packet requirements by 2025-08-01.

tickets.title: Determine ownership treatment for Tin Sparrow account
tickets.text: Determine and document the appropriate ownership treatment for the Tin Sparrow Investments account for Lydia Cloudpuddle. Clarify whether the account should be treated as probate or beneficiary property before final estate accounting.
tickets.evidence: The ownership treatment remains unresolved before estate accounting can be finalized, with follow-up needed by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Create cash‑flow calendar for condominium expenses
tickets.text: Create a cash‑flow calendar for condominium expenses, sale‑preparation costs, estate‑paid items, and co‑executor advances for Lydia Cloudpuddle. Include recurring costs and any personal advances to ensure fair coordination with co‑executor Calvin Velvetreed.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that calendar by 2025-08-06.

tickets.title: Coordinate retirement income plan preparation
tickets.text: Prepare a retirement income plan by separating data gathering, modeling, advisor review, and implementation tracking. Ensure each handoff documents assumptions, unresolved questions, and client-facing decisions. Review inherited IRA distribution options, tax impact, withholding preferences, and pacing relative to Lydia Cloudpuddle’s planned retirement at age 62. Complete this review by 2025-09-05.

subTasks.title: Compile income and expense inputs
subTasks.text: Gather expected retirement spending, Social Security estimates, pension details, annuity income, cash reserves, debt obligations, and planned one-time expenses.

subTasks.title: Build withdrawal scenario comparison
subTasks.text: Model base, conservative, and stress scenarios using portfolio withdrawals, tax-sensitive sequencing, required minimum distribution expectations, and reserve targets.

subTasks.title: Review strategy and client messaging
subTasks.text: Review the proposed income approach, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended talking points before the client presentation.

subTasks.title: Track approved implementation steps
subTasks.text: After advisor approval, track account setup, distribution instructions, cash reserve changes, and any follow-up documentation required from the client.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that review by 2025-09-05.

tickets.title: Perform recurring beneficiary designation review
tickets.text: At each annual review cycle, and after any reported major life event, confirm whether beneficiary designations should be reviewed for retirement accounts, insurance policies, transfer-on-death registrations, and education accounts. Document the date of the last confirmed beneficiary review, evidence available, discrepancies found, and any forms or custodian steps needed. Align Lydia Cloudpuddle’s contingent beneficiary designations so that both Mara and Theo are named equally across all retirement accounts, including the 401(k) and IRA. Complete this alignment by 2025-08-22.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the beneficiary alignment by 2025-08-22.

tickets.title: Obtain authorization for estate professional communication
tickets.text: Obtain written authorization allowing Sienna Bramblequill to discuss asset values, beneficiary registrations, basis information, and liquidity questions with the advisory team for Lydia Cloudpuddle. Secure the signed consent form by the required date.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the authorization by 2025-07-30.

tickets.title: Correct account name with Velvet Acorn Custody
tickets.text: Correct the account name with Velvet Acorn Custody from Lydia Velvetreed to Lydia Cloudpuddle. Coordinate with the custodian to update the registration before submitting the inherited IRA paperwork.
tickets.evidence: The mismatch may prevent acceptance of inherited account paperwork unless the custodian corrects the registration workflow, and the agreed follow-up is to address the name correction by 2025-08-04.
